basic_details.job_title: DRDO PXE Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 6 Research Associate, Junior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.short_information: Proof & Experimental Establishment (PXE), Chandipur (Pramaan tatha Prayogik Sthapana), an establishment of the Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO) under the Ministry of Defence, is offering 1 Research Associate (RA) fellowship at a stipend of Rs. 67,000/- per month and 5 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) fellowships at Rs. 37,000/- per month, each on a temporary basis for 2 years. The fellowships are in Electronics & Communication, Aerospace/Mechanical and Computer Science Engineering. age_limit.details: The age limit as on 16 October 2026 is 35 years for general candidates for the Research Associate (RA) position and 28 years for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) positions. Relaxation in age for SC/ST/OBC candidates is permissible as per Govt. rules. A caste certificate is needed to claim age relaxation. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Download the application form (Annexure-A) from the DRDO website, www.drdo.gov.in. The form is also attached to the notice.
Fill up the form by typing only. Incomplete or handwritten applications will be summarily rejected.

Affix a recent colour passport size photograph and give the details asked: fellowship category, discipline, personal details, reservation category, GATE/SLET/NET score card, examinations passed from Matriculation onwards and work experience.
Attach self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below, supporting your educational qualifications and experience.
Sign the declaration with place and date.
Write "Application for the position of JRF/RA" clearly on the envelope.

Send the application by Speed Post/ Regd. Post only to: The Director, Proof & Experimental Establishment (PXE), Defence R&D Organisation, PO- Chandipur, Dist- Balasore, Odisha -756025 (Kind Attn.: OIC, HRDC).
The application must reach the Establishment by 16 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: DRDO PXE Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Proof & Experimental Establishment (PXE), Chandipur, DRDO, Ministry of Defence
RA: Rs. 67,000/- per month; JRF: Rs. 37,000/- per month (stipend)
RA: 02 years; JRF: initially 02 years (temporary basis)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 6 fellowships in total across four rows. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up. The notice states that the notified fellowships are likely to be increased or decreased, and that the number filled will be based on the performance and suitability of candidates in the interview.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: PhD in Electronics & Communication Engg. having research work in the area of RF/ Microwave/ Radar Engg. OR all three of the following: (i) First Class M.E./M.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engg.; (ii) 3 years R&D experience in the area of RF & Microwave, Radar Cross Section Simulation and Measurements; (iii) at least one research paper in a Science Citation Index (SCI) journal. First Class B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics & Communication Engg. (EC) with valid GATE Score in EC in the year 2024, 2025 or 2026 OR M.E./M.Tech. in Electronics & Communication Engg. & First division both at Graduate and Post Graduate level. First Class B.E./B.Tech. in Aerospace Engg. (AE)/ Mechanical Engg. (ME) with valid GATE Score in AE/ME in the year 2024, 2025 or 2026 OR M.E./M.Tech in Aerospace Engg. / Mechanical Engg. & First division both at Graduate and Post Graduate level. First Class B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Sc. Engg. (CS) with valid GATE Score in CS in the year 2024, 2025 or 2026 OR M.E./M.Tech. in Computer Science Engg. & First division both at Graduate and Post Graduate level. The age limit as on 16 October 2026 is 35 years for general candidates for the Research Associate (RA) position and 28 years for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) positions. Relaxation in age for SC/ST/OBC candidates is permissible as per Govt. rules. A caste certificate is needed to claim age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification_short: PhD in ECE with RF/Microwave/Radar research, OR First Class M.E./M.Tech in ECE with 3 years R&D experience and an SCI paper
First Class B.E./B.Tech in EC with valid GATE (EC), OR M.E./M.Tech in ECE with first division at both levels
First Class B.E./B.Tech in AE/ME with valid GATE (AE/ME), OR M.E./M.Tech in AE/ME with first division at both levels
First Class B.E./B.Tech in CS with valid GATE (CS), OR M.E./M.Tech in CSE with first division at both levels

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: A monthly stipend is paid as per GoI norms (Min. of Defence (Fin/R&D) letter No. 01/RD/HRD/89-90/751/D(R&D) dated 08 August 2023): Rs. 67,000/- per month for the Research Associate (RA) and Rs. 37,000/- per month for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF). The Research Associate (RA) tenure is for a period of 02 (two) years only, on temporary basis. The Junior Research Fellow (JRF) tenure is initially 02 (two) years on temporary basis. Based on performance, it may be upgraded to Senior Research Fellow (SRF) for 01 (one) year and is extendable by another 01 (one) year as SRF. The offer does not confer any right for absorption in DRDO, since it is not an employment, and the period served as RA/Research Fellow will not be counted in any post of DRDO or other government departments.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DRDO PXE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form (Annexure-A) from the DRDO website, www.drdo.gov.in . The form is also attached to the notice. Fill up the form by typing only. Incomplete or handwritten applications will be summarily rejected. Affix a recent colour passport size photograph and give the details asked: fellowship category, discipline, personal details, reservation category, GATE/SLET/NET score card, examinations passed from Matriculation onwards and work experience. Attach self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below, supporting your educational qualifications and experience. Sign the declaration with place and date. Write "Application for the position of JRF/RA" clearly on the envelope. Send the application by Speed Post/ Regd. Post only to: The Director, Proof & Experimental Establishment (PXE), Defence R&D Organisation, PO- Chandipur, Dist- Balasore, Odisha -756025 (Kind Attn.: OIC, HRDC). The application must reach the Establishment by 16 December 2026. Educational/ Professional Certificates 10th Certificate/ Birth Certificate Caste Certificate (for age relaxation) Work Experience Certificate Aadhaar Card Valid Score Card (GATE/ SLET/ NET) NOC from present Employer (if applicable) Research publications (applicable only for RA)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: After scrutinising the applications, PXE will shortlist candidates based on the relevance of their research work experience, and the shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Selection will be made on the basis of an interview held through video conferencing. Candidates will be informed by email about the further process. Admission to the selection process cannot be claimed as a matter of right; the selection committee of the laboratory may refuse to admit any candidate without assigning any reason. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DRDO PXE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 fellowships: 1 Research Associate (RA) and 5 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) – 3 in Electronics & Communication Engg., 1 in Aerospace/Mechanical Engg. and 1 in Computer Science Engg.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the PXE Chandipur RA and JRF posts?
faq.answer: Applications must reach PXE, Chandipur by 16 December 2026, sent by Speed Post or Registered Post only.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the PXE JRF posts?
faq.answer: A First Class B.E./B.Tech in the relevant discipline (EC, AE/ME or CS) with a valid GATE score in that subject from 2024, 2025 or 2026, or an M.E./M.Tech in that discipline with first division at both graduate and post graduate level.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for DRDO PXE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As on 16 October 2026, the upper age limit is 35 years for general candidates for Research Associate and 28 years for Junior Research Fellow, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC as per Govt. rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for PXE RA and JRF?
faq.answer: The Research Associate gets Rs. 67,000/- per month and the Junior Research Fellow gets Rs. 37,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the PXE Chandipur fellowships?
faq.answer: Type the Annexure-A form, attach self-attested documents, write "Application for the position of JRF/RA" on the envelope and send it by Speed Post or Registered Post to The Director, PXE, PO- Chandipur, Dist- Balasore, Odisha -756025 (Kind Attn.: OIC, HRDC).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinised, candidates are shortlisted on the relevance of their research work experience, and selection is made through an interview held by video conferencing.

faq.question: Q8. Is the DRDO PXE JRF a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The JRF tenure is initially 2 years on temporary basis, may be upgraded to SRF for 1 year and extended by another year, and the notice states it is not an employment and gives no right to absorption in DRDO.

faq.question: Q9. Can I fill the PXE application form by hand?
faq.answer: No. The form must be filled by typing only; incomplete or handwritten applications will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for the PXE interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview, document verification or joining the duty on selection.
